review_response_tasks.stem: Here is some ____ for you. You can drink it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：some water不可数，和is及drink it一致。；B：oranges复数不与is和it一致，也不能直接当饮品。；C：pies复数不与is、it及drink一致。

review_response_tasks.stem: It's four o'clock. It's time ____ go to the art room.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：后面是动词go，time for不直接接此动词原形。；B：time in go不是该结构。；C：time to加动词原形go。

review_response_tasks.stem: —How many ____ do you have this morning? —Three: English, Maths and PE.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：How many要求复数，不能用单数lesson。；B：How many lessons复数一致，后面列三节。；C：后面是三种课而非铅笔，语义不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: We read ____ six ____ the evening ____ Sundays.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：钟点at six、时段in the evening、星期on Sundays全部成立。；B：钟点不用on，星期前此处不用at。；C：一般时段the evening用in，星期用on。

review_response_tasks.stem: Lily has new jeans. Look at ____ jeans! ____ blue.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：jeans前需形容词性物主代词，不用主格she。；B：jeans为复数，不用It is。；C：Lily用her修饰jeans，复数用They are。

review_response_tasks.stem: I have only blue pencils, not red ones. I can lend a ____ pencil, but not a ____ one.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：把已有和没有的颜色反过来了。；B：符合只有蓝笔、没有红笔。；C：第一空红笔与only blue冲突。

review_response_tasks.stem: My dad is a teacher. —____ your ____ at school? —Yes, he is.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：dad为单数，和Is及he一致。；B：dad为单数，不用Are。；C：sisters是复数，与Is和he都不一致。
A：Who is问人，不在bag前表示谁的。；B：后句所有关系需Anna的所有格。；C：Whose问谁的，名词所有格回答。

review_response_tasks.stem: —I'm sad. Our outdoor game is cancelled. —____
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：称赞完成得好不回应所说的难过和取消。；B：直接回应坏消息并表示同情。；C：没有生日情境，不合此回应。

review_response_tasks.stem: I cannot lift this box alone. Can you give me a hand? Here, “give me a hand” means ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：无法独自抬箱子是在请求帮助。；B：上下文不是赠送身体部位。；C：不是在要求举手，而是请求帮忙抬箱。
